iii) Calculate the expansion allowance required for the stress in the rail to be zero when the temperature reaches $60^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Take $\alpha = 12 \times 10^{-6}$ and $E = 2 \times 10^5\ \text{N/mm}^2$.
